headline: Ontario's AI economy grows; literacy as a system problem
digest: Vector's Ontario snapshot reported 121 new AI firms, $3.9B in VC and a 61% rise in non-technical jobs requiring AI skills, which supports the case for AI literacy beyond STEM careers. Digital Moment won a CIRA grant for Grades 3–8 critical AI skills and argued AI literacy is a 'whole-system challenge'. A U of T history course is teaching critical AI thinking through past technologies.
